title: Require CLI Command Module Semantics
forbids: CLI topic command modules without exactly one oclif Command default, with another value export, an authored static command id or duplicate path-derived id, or whose local dependencies resolve outside the topic's src/adapters interior
why: A discovered command module must be an executable oclif command, while reusable topic-local behavior has one qualified owner outside the command discovery tree. Lexical import spelling cannot prove either relation.
remediate: Default-export exactly one concrete oclif Command subclass, delete authored static id members, choose one collision-free command path, move reusable behavior below the same topic's src/adapters tree, and replace command-to-command or unresolved relative dependencies with an adapter-owned capability.
message: CLI topic command modules must have one path-derived oclif identity and depend locally only on their topic adapter interior.
